name: Kagura Kaentan
source:
This roguelike RPG is the latest game in Debonosu’s Kagura series. This world is different from the the human world. There are youkai who normally hide in the shadows or sunlight, but can harm humans. Mikoto and Ryouka are two mikos under the tutelage of the goddess Sakatome-sama, and they are tasked with exterminating the youkai. They travel across the land as part of their training. One day, they arrived at a history-laden old town upon the request of Satsuki and Takayo, who informed them of strange events occurring around the town. That evening, Takayo was kidnapped by the youkai and the mikos headed to the land of the youkai to save her.


[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/04/01/april-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这款Roguelike RPG是Debonosu神乐系列的最新游戏。这个世界与人类世界不同。有些妖怪通常隐藏在阴影或阳光下，但也会伤害人类。美琴和燎香是女神坂留大人门下的两名巫女，她们的任务是消灭妖怪。作为训练的一部分，他们穿越陆地。有一天，他们在小月和高代的要求下来到了一座充满历史的古镇，小月和高代向他们讲述了小镇周围发生的奇怪事件。当晚，高世被妖怪绑架，巫女们前往妖怪之地营救她。


[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/04/01/april-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
